The Statistics Canada table that covers this topic, 11-10-0090-01 (Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status), reports Canada only, with no provincial breakdown. I searched the other disability-related tables and found no provincial poverty or low-income data. I'm not going to estimate an Alberta figure.

**National figure, for reference:**
- 12.6% of persons with disabilities aged 15 and over were below the poverty line in 2024. This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base).
- Source: Statistics Canada, table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452, reference period 2024. It was released 2026-04-29.
- The same series was 12.8% in 2023 and 12.9% in 2022.

Statistics Canada may publish Alberta figures in custom tabulations or in the Canadian Survey on Disability reports, but I couldn't verify that here.
